title: Not the best quality
text: Not the best quality. After initial washing/drying they are all ready balling up. I think it’s probably smarter to go with a thicker 100% cotton apron to avoid this. The strap, though adjustable, is thick and cuts into neck. These are more decorative than utilitarian.
